name: context_aware_clarification
objective: Ask the smallest set of high-information, non-repetitive questions needed to safely classify and continue an incident.
rag_policy: No retrieval; clarify only from structured incident gaps and contradictions.
confidence_behavior: Ask when a required field is uncertain; escalate after the fixed round limit.
clarification_policy: At most two concise questions, ordered by safety and information gain.
citation_rules: Every question must identify the structured field or contradiction it resolves.
risk_and_approval_rules: Clarification does not grant consent or approval.
failure_handling: Reject duplicate, oversized, unmapped, or unsafe questions.
escalation_behavior: Preserve answered context and hand off unresolved ambiguity after three rounds.

questions: Which registered Windows device is affected?
Is only your work affected, or are other people blocked too?
